fact: The national Data Center (600 m2, COREX) was officially launched on 4 September 2025, and the presidency's chief of cabinet said it is open to offering hosting services, including for other countries' data.

COREX's deputy director-general said the national Data Center is certified Tier 3 Design by Uptime Institute, with Tier 3 construction certification still to come; the article calls it the country's first Tier III data centre.

Guineenews reports that at the 4 September 2025 launch of the national Data Center (Tier III, 600 m2, built and presented by COREX), the telecommunications minister said Guinea's strategic data now stays in Guinea under state control, instead of being hosted abroad at over USD 5 million a year; the document does not name which ministries' systems are moved.

GUILAB's own page describes its operating data centre at the Centre Emetteur de Kipé, Conakry (228.91 m2, colocation room linked to a meet-me room) serving telecom operators, ISPs and other customers; the page carries no date, so as_of is its 2025 copyright year.
Data centres dataset: GUILAB Data Centre (GUILAB SA), colocation/carrier-neutral, in service; this document names it (published 2020-10-01).
